intent: A grid arena of breakable blocks where every player drops one bomb at a time; a bomb blows up after 3 s in a cross, breaking blocks and detonating every bomb it reaches, and each knockout in the chain is credited to whoever's bomb started it. Knocked-out players respawn after 3 s with 2 s protection; the most knockouts in a 180 s round wins, then 5 s of results and a fresh arena.
accept: Players move on a grid and drop a bomb with the action button, only one live bomb per player
A bomb explodes after 3 s as a cross that breaks blocks and sets off other bombs it reaches in a chain
A knockout caused by a chain reaction is scored for the owner of the bomb that started the chain
Knocked-out players respawn after 3 s at a free spot with 2 s of protection, and the 180 s round ends with 5 s results then a new arena
The before/after clip shows bombs, a visible fuse, cross-shaped blasts and a score display

criteria.text: Players move on a grid and drop a bomb with the action button, only one live bomb per player
criteria.evidence: after/shot-1..3: bots on grid, one bomb each; test 'one live bomb per player, one per fresh press'

criteria.text: A bomb explodes after 3 s as a cross that breaks blocks and sets off other bombs it reaches in a chain
criteria.evidence: tests 'go off exactly 3 s', 'blast cross stops at pillars and breaks only the first brick'; after/shot-3 shows bricks cleared vs shot-1. No blast cross captured in a shot.

criteria.text: A knockout caused by a chain reaction is scored for the owner of the bomb that started the chain
criteria.evidence: test 'chain reaction: every knockout goes to the owner of the bomb that started it'; after/shot-3 shows '+2 KO' popup and bot5 2 on scoreboard

criteria.text: Knocked-out players respawn after 3 s at a free spot with 2 s of protection, and the 180 s round ends with 5 s results then a new arena
criteria.evidence: tests 'respawn after 3 s...' and 'round loop'; after/shot-3 shows ghost with X eyes; timer counts 2:58 to 2:50

criteria.text: The before/after clip shows bombs, a visible fuse, cross-shaped blasts and a score display
criteria.evidence: after shots show bombs with lit fuses, red glow late-fuse, KNOCKOUTS scoreboard, round timer; before is a different game (tower climber). Cross blasts not in a still but drawn by drawBlast.

findings: Minor: player name labels overlap when bots share/adjoin cells (bot2/bot10, bot9/bot3), likely cause of the OCR gate failure; in assets.ts nameStyle could offset dy per player or shrink size. HUD text itself (timer, KNOCKOUTS) is legible.
